DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Title: Experience
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Mode.Split.Label: Split a total
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Mode.Split.Hint: One figure for the whole party, divided evenly — the book's own way (Player's Book p25)
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Mode.Each.Label: Per character
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Mode.Each.Hint: Type what each character earned, and let the window do the modifiers
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Total.Label: Party XP
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Total.Note.One: Divided evenly between the {count} counted below, then that character's own modifier.
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Total.Note.Other: Divided evenly between the {count} counted below, then each character's own modifier.
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Total.Reckon: Press <kbd>Enter</kbd> or click away to reckon it.
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Each.Hint: Type what each one earned in the Earned column. The half share and the Prime Ability modifier are still applied on top — this only skips the dividing.
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Remainder.Label: {n} left over
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Remainder.Hint: What the division could not place, plus anything you took off a row by hand. The book does not say who gets the odd point, so nobody does until you say so.
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Overspent.Label: {n} over the total
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Overspent.Hint: The shares below add up to more than the party earned, because a row was raised by hand. Nothing stops you — it is only worth knowing.
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Row.Include.Hint: Counted when the total is divided. Untick for anyone who was not there.
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Row.Share.Hint: This character's share is set to {pct}% on the sheet — at 50 that is the book's rule for an adventurer retainer (Player's Book p25).
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Row.Percent.Hint: No Class to read it from, so this is the XP bonus field on the sheet. Typing here writes it there — set it once and it stays.
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Row.LevelUp.Label: May level
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Row.LevelUp.Hint: Passes {next} XP, the threshold on the attribute sheet. Taking the Level is a separate step on the sheet — it costs time and coins.
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Row.Capped.Label: capped, {lost} lost
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Row.Capped.Hint: The house cap stops a character at the threshold two Levels above them ({at} XP). {lost} XP had nowhere to go and were not credited.
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Row.Reset.Hint: Put this row back on the even share
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Empty: No party characters this module can read. XP is kept by the game system, so a character needs Ability Scores before it can be credited any.
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Clear.Label: Clear
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Clear.Hint: Empty every field and count everyone again
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Prime.FromClass: {class}: Prime {abilities}. The lowest score decides it — {lowest}.
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Prime.ByHand: {class}, but the modifier was set by hand on the attribute sheet and that is what counts here.
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Prime.UnknownClass: "{class}" is not a Class this module knows, so the modifier comes from the XP bonus field on the sheet.
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Prime.NoClass: No Class on the sheet, so the modifier comes from the XP bonus field.
DOLMENWOOD.Xp.Confirm.NoUndo: Their XP totals are written straight to the sheet. There is no undo.
DOLMENWOOD.Trash.Title: Trash
DOLMENWOOD.Trash.PlayerHint: These are the items you deleted. Ask your GM to put one back.
DOLMENWOOD.Trash.Row.Delete.Hint: Throw this one away for good, and leave the rest of the bin alone
DOLMENWOOD.Trash.Restore.Failed: That item could not be restored — nowhere to put it.
DOLMENWOOD.Trash.Restore.Fallback: Restored to {zone} — the zone it came from is gone or full.
DOLMENWOOD.Trash.Discard.Title: Throw Away
DOLMENWOOD.Trash.Discard.Hint: It cannot be restored afterwards. The rest of the bin is untouched.
DOLMENWOOD.Trash.EmptyActor.Title: Empty Trash
DOLMENWOOD.Trash.EmptyActor.Body.One: Throw away {count} deleted item from {name}'s trash? This cannot be undone.
DOLMENWOOD.Trash.EmptyActor.Body.Other: Throw away {count} deleted items from {name}'s trash? This cannot be undone.
DOLMENWOOD.Trash.EmptyAll.Label: Empty all
DOLMENWOOD.Trash.EmptyAll.Title: Empty All Trash
DOLMENWOOD.Trash.EmptyAll.Body.One: Throw away {count} deleted item across {where}? This cannot be undone.
DOLMENWOOD.Trash.EmptyAll.Body.Other: Throw away {count} deleted items across {where}? This cannot be undone.

DOLMENWOOD.Market.Dialog.OwnStock.Label: Sells only its own stock
DOLMENWOOD.Market.Dialog.OwnStock.Hint: Nothing from the catalogue, only what you put on this stall's shelf yourself. The categories below are then ignored.
DOLMENWOOD.Market.Dialog.Categories.Hint: Leave every box unticked to sell the whole catalogue. Treasures are never on a shelf by category — put one there with From Catalogue inside the shop.

DOLMENWOOD.Loot.NoCharacter.Item: You have no character to put this into.
DOLMENWOOD.Loot.NoCharacter.Coins: You have no character to put coins into.

DOLMENWOOD.Inn.QualityFixed.Hint: Set when this inn was placed
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.Release.Open.Label: Open to the party
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.Release.Closed.Label: Closed
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.Release.Open.Hint: The party can reach this inn from the toolbar and the day bar. Click to close it to them again — anyone with it open will have it taken away.
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.Release.Closed.Hint: Only you can reach this inn. Name it and set its quality first, then open it: the party is told in chat and the doors appear on their toolbar and day bar.
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.NewDay.Label: New day
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.NewDay.Hint: Start a new in-game day: clears this list and re-rolls every inn's menu
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.Section.Quality.Hint: This section differs from the house quality

DOLMENWOOD.Inn.Section.Reset.Hint: Discard this section's changes and start over from the book
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.BuyForOther.Hint: Buy for someone else — you pay
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.NeedsGM: paying at the inn needs a GM online
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.Pay.Title: Pay for {what}
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.Treat.Title: Buy for someone else
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.Treat.Hint: You pay — it goes on their tab.
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.NobodyElse: There is nobody else to buy for.
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.NewDay.Title: Start a new day
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.NewDay.Body: Clear the day's lodging and food for everyone, and re-roll the menu at every inn?
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.RemoveLine.Title: Remove line
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.ResetSection.Title: Reset section
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.ResetSection.Body: Discard every change to this section and rebuild it from the book?
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.ChangeQuality.Title: Change quality
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.ChangeQuality.Body:
This inn has its own edited tables. Changing the quality rebuilds every section from the book and discards those edits.

Continue?
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.TakeAway.SubContainer: {portions} portions for the price of {price} — {cost}, {weight} wt
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.Line.Name.Label: Name
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.Line.Group.Label: Group
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.Line.Group.Note: (decides which daily draw it belongs to)
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.Line.Tag.Label: Small label
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.Line.Unit.Label: Price suffix
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.Line.Container.Label: Sold to take away as
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.Line.Container.Hint: “Automatic” follows the house's switch and the type above — cask for beer and cider, bottle for wine, spirits and specialities, nothing for tea. A fixed choice overrides the house switch in both directions.
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.Line.Grants.Label: Hands over
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.Line.Grants.Hint: Normally nothing — what is bought at an inn is consumed on the spot. Pick a catalog item and this line becomes a purchase of goods instead: it goes into a pack, with a target zone and an amount, and it stacks with the same item bought in a shop. This is how rations work.
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.Line.Fixed.Label: Always available
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.Line.Fixed.Hint: The house's own brew or signature dish — never part of the daily roll.
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.SectionDialog.Title: Section settings
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.SectionDialog.Quality.Hin: Changing this rebuilds the section from the book — the three levels are separate tables.
Sells drink by the bottle and cask
The house default. A single drink can still be set to its own answer, which wins either way — so a house that sells nothing to take away can still let its own brew out by the cask.
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.SectionDialog.Draw.Legend: How many are served each day
DOLMENWOOD.Inn.SectionDialog.Draw.Hint: Leave a pair empty to serve every line in that group.
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.Name.Hint: Name this shop — leave empty for none
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.BuyBack.Hint: This shop buys what you bring in at {pct}% of its own value
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.Shelf.Own.Label: Own shelf
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.Shelf.Own.Hint: This shop sells only what you have put on its shelf. Click to sell the whole catalogue instead.
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.Shelf.Catalogue.Label: Catalogue
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.Shelf.Catalogue.Hint: This shop sells the whole catalogue. Click to keep it to its own shelf — which is what makes it a shop rather than a warehouse.
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.Release.Open.Label: Open to the party
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.Release.Open.Hint: The party can reach this shop from the toolbar, the day bar and their own inventory. Click to shut it again — anyone with it open will have it taken away.
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.Release.Closed.Label: Closed
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.Release.Closed.Hint: Only you can reach this shop. Name it and stock it first, then open it: the party is told in chat and the doors on their bar light up.
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.Coins.Label: Coins:
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.Coins.Hint: Every coin {name} is carrying, wherever it is stowed — belt, pack, cart and all
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.Affordable.Label: Affordable
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.Affordable.Hint: Show only items you can afford
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.SellMode.Label: Sell
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.SellMode.Hint: Sell what {name} is carrying — this shop pays {pct}% of an item's own value
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.Shelves.Label: Shelves
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.CustomItem.HintGM: Add a custom item to the selected party member

DOLMENWOOD.Shop.AddToShop.HintGeneral: Add goods or a service that stay in the general shop permanently
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.FromCatalogue.Label: From Catalogue
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.FromCatalogue.Hint: Put catalogue items on this shelf by hand — including the treasures that are never on sale by default
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.AddService.Label: Add a Service
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.AddService.Hint: Put a service on this shelf: the Player's Book specialists, and whatever you have written yourself
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.NewVisit.Label: New visit
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.NewVisit.Hint: Roll again for everything this shop stocks on a chance. Visit {n}.
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.SellView.Note: {shop} pays {pct}% of what a thing is worth — reckoned on its own value, not on this shop's asking price.
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.SellView.OnlyTrade: It takes only what it deals in: {list}.
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.SellView.NoZones: Anything that carries a zone of its own (a backpack, a cart) is not listed: selling one would have to decide what happens to everything inside it.
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.SellView.Fill.Label: {used} of {capacity}
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.SellView.Fill.Hint: The shop pays for what is in it, not for the empty container

DOLMENWOOD.Shop.Badge.Out.Label: out this visit
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.Badge.Out.Hint: Stocked on a {n}-in-6 chance, and not in this visit. Players do not see this row at all.
DOLMENWOOD.Shop.Badge.Chance.Label: {n}-in-6
